source_contract: 822 PASS / 0 FAIL authoritative post-Batch-2B baseline; Batch 2C adds Car Affordability & Auto Decision deterministic and discovery contracts

engines.name: SIP / Recurring Investment
engines.inputs: mode, years, current savings, recurring contribution, contribution frequency, annual return, annual step-up, goal/target amount, inflation
engines.outputs: projected value, invested amount, growth, goal funding, required contribution, additional contribution, time to target, annual series
engines.state: carrowmont_plan_context_v1; locale continuity; compatible housing context read-only
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale; India SIP vs international recurring-investment wording; pay/contribution frequency semantics preserved
engines.fre_role: Growth, goal funding and contribution adequacy engine.

engines.name: Goal Planner
engines.inputs: goal type/name, years, current cost, inflation, current savings, recurring contribution, pay/contribution frequency, return, future lump sum and timing
engines.outputs: future goal cost, projected funding, gap, required recurring contribution, additional contribution, lump sum needed today, funding ratio
engines.state: Shared plan bridge + locale continuity
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale; contribution/pay frequency independence
engines.fre_role: Goal trade-off and funding-gap engine. Pure deterministic core extracted in Batch 1B and available through the standard FRE adapter contract.

engines.name: Financial Independence
engines.inputs: current/target age, sustainable vs plan-until-age mode, spending, income, withdrawal rate, inflation, assets, recurring contribution, frequencies, return, step-up
engines.outputs: FI target, modeled FI timing, required contribution, target projection, post-FI longevity, annual journey and chart series
engines.state: Shared plan bridge + locale continuity
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale; pay and investment frequencies independent
engines.fre_role: Long-term independence and retirement-adjacent planning engine.

engines.name: Inflation / Purchasing Power
engines.inputs: amount, future-cost vs purchasing-power mode, years, inflation rate
engines.outputs: future equivalent/purchasing power, cumulative change, annual chart values
engines.state: Shared plan bridge + locale continuity
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale and currency formatting
engines.fre_role: Common inflation transformer used by goals, retirement and explanations. Pure deterministic core extracted in Batch 1B.

engines.name: Retirement Planner
engines.inputs: ages, lifestyle/expense model, income, existing assets, contributions, inflation types, return assumptions, retirement goals and planning horizon
engines.outputs: required corpus, projected corpus, contribution gap, retirement spending, portfolio simulation, depletion/remaining balance, journey data
engines.state: Shared plan bridge + locale continuity; withdrawal handoff key
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale; retirement terminology/currency
engines.fre_role: Primary retirement adequacy engine. Pure deterministic core extracted in Batch 1B and available through the standard FRE adapter contract.

engines.name: Budget & Cash Flow
engines.inputs: income rows, essential/flexible expense rows, saving rows, frequencies, payday/available cash, emergency reserve and target months
engines.outputs: monthly income/spending/saving, remaining cash, savings rate, weekly/daily safe amount, pay-cycle room, emergency coverage/target/gap
engines.state: Local budget storage + carrowmont_plan_context_v1; can stage possible monthly debt extra
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale; pay-cycle terminology
engines.fre_role: Stabilize/Protect foundation. Pure deterministic core extracted in Batch 1B and available through the standard FRE adapter contract.

engines.name: Mortgage / Home Loan Payoff
engines.inputs: balance, annual rate, remaining duration, payment frequency/convention, optional current payment, recurring extra, lump sum/extra-event cadence, payoff target
engines.outputs: scheduled payment, baseline/scenario payoff, total interest, interest/time saved, annual summary, monthly equivalent, payoff date
engines.state: Writes housingLoan.* to carrowmont_plan_context_v1; separate carrowmontMortgageDecisionV1 profile
engines.localization: Shared mortgage terminology layer: Home Loan/Mortgage/Overpayment/extra repayment conventions
engines.reports: Shared report-standard.js + Mortgage payoff PDF renderer
engines.fre_role: Housing debt engine and source profile for mortgage decision tools.

engines.name: Compound Interest
engines.inputs: principal, annual rate, years, compounding frequency, optional recurring contribution/frequency/timing, optional inflation
engines.outputs: ending value, contributed amount, growth, effective annual rate, simple-vs-compound difference, real ending value, annual series
engines.state: Shared plan context; stores compatible compound assumptions
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale/currency formatting
engines.fre_role: Generic deterministic growth engine for savings and scenario comparisons.

engines.name: Loan / EMI
engines.inputs: loan amount or target payment, rate, term, first payment date, fees, recurring extra payment, one-time extra payment/timing
engines.outputs: modeled principal/payment, baseline/scenario schedule, total interest/repayment/fees, payoff date, time/interest saved, annual summary
engines.state: Shared plan context + locale continuity
engines.localization: Loan/EMI/repayment/payment terms through shared locale layer
engines.fre_role: General borrowing-cost and repayment engine.

engines.name: Debt Payoff
engines.inputs: multiple debts with balances/APRs/minimums, available monthly payment/extra payment, payoff strategy
engines.outputs: payoff time, interest, schedule, debt order and plan comparisons
engines.state: Can receive staged monthly extra from Budget; not a general profile store
engines.localization: Currency/localized copy handled in UI layer
engines.reports: Debt payoff PDF renderer; surrounding repo uses shared report standard
engines.fre_role: Reduce-stage debt prioritization and payoff scenario engine.

engines.name: Retirement Withdrawal / Drawdown / SWP
engines.inputs: starting portfolio, withdrawal amount/mode, withdrawal frequency/timing, return, inflation/escalation, horizon and related limits
engines.outputs: portfolio path, withdrawal schedule, depletion/ending balance, annual summary, sustainable-starting-withdrawal solve, sensitivity
engines.state: Uses retirement withdrawal handoff where applicable
engines.localization: Country/currency UI layer; SWP wording where appropriate
engines.fre_role: Post-retirement income and longevity engine.

engines.name: Home Affordability / Borrowing Power
engines.inputs: take-home income, essential spending, existing debt, protected savings, desired buffer, home-price/budget mode, down payment, rate, term and housing costs
engines.outputs: affordable/target scenario, payment, all-in housing cost, monthly leftover, cash-flow breakdown, higher-rate stress result, warnings
engines.state: No bank connection; uses page inputs and shared locale
engines.localization: Mortgage/Home Loan labels and currency from main-site locale
engines.fre_role: Core Can-I-afford-a-home decision engine.

engines.name: Rent vs Buy
engines.inputs: rent, purchase price, mortgage terms, ownership costs, horizon, growth/investment assumptions and transaction costs
engines.outputs: rent/buy wealth paths, monthly/cumulative costs, crossover classification and deterministic fixtures
engines.state: Mortgage family only; no permanent personal profile beyond existing compatible context
engines.localization: Housing terminology/currency via mortgage locale layer
engines.fre_role: Housing choice scenario engine.

engines.name: Mortgage Prepay vs Invest
engines.inputs: confirmed mortgage profile, extra cash/cash-flow choice, prepayment timing, user-controlled investment return and comparison horizon
engines.outputs: equal-cash-flow prepay path vs invest path, break-even, ending values and comparison series
engines.state: Uses explicit-use mortgage decision profile; decision assumptions are not persisted into the profile
engines.localization: Mortgage family terminology; investment wording remains country-aware
engines.fre_role: High-value Resolution Engine journey: pay mortgage or invest.

engines.name: Mortgage Refinance / Balance Transfer Break-Even
engines.inputs: current/new balance/rate/term/payment assumptions, fees, cashback, holding period and refinance timing
engines.outputs: new payment/cost, cumulative savings, durable break-even timing, equivalence and sensitivity
engines.state: Can use confirmed mortgage profile; current-payment profile overrides cannot silently drive comparison
engines.localization: Mortgage/refinance/transfer wording via family layer
engines.fre_role: Refinance/transfer decision journey.

engines.name: Mortgage Rate Rise / Payment Stress
engines.inputs: mortgage profile, current/renewal/reset rate scenarios, income/budget buffer and stress ladder
engines.outputs: payment ladder, monthly equivalent, buffer impact, zero-buffer rate and stress classifications
engines.state: Can use confirmed mortgage profile; no silent profile assumption override
engines.localization: Mortgage family terminology and payment-frequency semantics
engines.fre_role: Housing resilience/stress journey.

engines.name: 4% Rule Stress Test
engines.inputs: portfolio, withdrawal rate, inflation, nominal return, retirement duration/age assumptions
engines.outputs: base/cautious/adverse paths, sequence-risk comparison, rate comparison, depletion/ending balances
engines.state: Standalone scenario engine
engines.localization: Currency formatting from main-site locale; methodology globally neutral
engines.fre_role: Retirement withdrawal risk/sequence explanation.

engines.name: FI Number by Spending
engines.inputs: spending amount/frequency, withdrawal-rate assumptions, optional future-year/inflation sensitivity
engines.outputs: annual spending, FI number, rate comparison and spending sensitivity
engines.state: Includes FI spending handoff where applicable
engines.localization: Currency and recurring terminology via main site
engines.fre_role: Fast FI target estimator / supporting explanation engine.

engines.name: US Debt & Interest Cost
engines.inputs: debt basis/starting debt, average/refinancing rate, rollover/projection assumptions
engines.outputs: debt-interest scenarios, rate sensitivity and explanatory summary
engines.state: Bundled/reference data; not personal profile data
engines.localization: US macro-specific by design
engines.fre_role: Research/context only. Must not directly drive personal recommendations without an explicit bridge.

engines.name: Gold Under Macro Stress
engines.inputs: six bounded macro driver states plus versioned bundled reference scores
engines.outputs: qualitative environment classification, supportive/headwind drivers and interpretation
engines.state: Bundled same-origin reference data; weekly updater protects reviewed fields
engines.localization: Globally neutral; no price forecast
engines.fre_role: Macro education/context only; never a personal buy/sell engine.

engines.name: Silver Supply, Demand & Macro Stress
engines.inputs: versioned physical supply/demand reference, bounded physical adjustments, real-yield/dollar macro states
engines.outputs: physical balance class, macro class, combined qualitative interpretation and force map
engines.state: Bundled same-origin annual reference + shared gold macro reference
engines.localization: Globally neutral physical units; no local-currency price forecast
engines.fre_role: Macro education/context only.

engines.name: Market Chain Reaction Explorer
engines.inputs: approved event/state graph selection and hash state
engines.outputs: validated chain relations/resolution state
engines.state: Bundled market-chain event/relation/source data
engines.localization: Global educational framing
engines.fre_role: Macro relationship education/context, not a personal recommendation engine.

engines.name: Emergency Fund & Financial Runway
engines.inputs: essential monthly expenses, unavoidable debt payments, other essential commitments, emergency savings, optional other liquid cash, user-chosen target months, monthly contribution, disruption income and one-time shock cost
engines.outputs: monthly essential need, emergency-ready reserve, full-income-loss runway, stress runway, first-stage gap, user-target amount/gap/coverage, build-time estimates and 3–6 month reference amounts
engines.state: Guest-first and calculation-local in Batch 2A; no new financial-value persistence. Eligible for later My Carrowmont profile mapping only after explicit design approval.
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale across 59 region profiles / 48 currencies; terminology deliberately neutral in v1.
engines.reports: Dedicated three-page Emergency Fund & Financial Runway PDF plus CSV and Copy Summary.
engines.fre_role: Protect-stage resilience engine. Provides deterministic runway and reserve-gap evidence for Ask Carrowmont; 3–6 months is context only, while the target is user chosen.

engines.name: Debt-to-Income & Borrowing Health
engines.inputs: gross monthly income, optional take-home income, essential non-debt expenses, mortgage/home-loan payment, other loan payments, credit-card minimums, other debt payments, optional proposed new monthly debt payment and income-drop stress percentage
engines.outputs: current debt payments, current/proposed gross-income DTI, DTI change, take-home debt share, current/proposed monthly cash room, stressed gross income and stressed DTI
engines.state: Guest-first and calculation-local in Batch 2B; no new financial-value persistence. Eligible for later My Carrowmont profile mapping only after explicit design approval.
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale across 59 region profiles / 48 currencies; no country-specific underwriting threshold in v1.
engines.reports: Dedicated three-page Debt-to-Income & Borrowing Health PDF plus CSV and Copy Summary.
engines.fre_role: Reduce-stage borrowing-health engine. Provides deterministic ratio, new-payment and household cash-room evidence for the Financial Resolution Assistant without predicting lender approval.

engines.name: Car Affordability & Auto Decision
engines.inputs: vehicle price, cash down payment, trade-in credit, upfront taxes/fees, loan rate/term, gross and take-home income, essential expenses, existing debt payments, monthly running costs, emergency savings, emergency savings used for purchase, user-chosen runway target, stress assumptions and optional comparison scenarios
engines.outputs: loan amount/payment/interest, all-in monthly car cost, before/after monthly cash room, current/after-loan gross-income DTI, before/after emergency runway, higher-cost stress result and user-entered alternative scenario comparisons
engines.state: Guest-first and calculation-local in Batch 2C; no new financial-value persistence. Eligible for later My Carrowmont profile mapping only after explicit design approval.
engines.localization: Shared CarrowmontLocale across 59 region profiles / 48 currencies; neutral car/vehicle wording and no country-specific lender rule in v1.
engines.reports: Dedicated three-page Car Affordability & Auto Decision PDF plus CSV and Copy Summary.
engines.fre_role: Build-stage purchase decision engine. Reuses Loan / EMI, Borrowing Health and Emergency Fund deterministic engines so the Financial Resolution Assistant can assess a car purchase without duplicating payment, DTI or runway mathematics.

fre_batch1b_contract.formula_change: none intended; parity fixtures and existing browser regressions are release gates

fre_batch2a.release_gate: Publisher browser/PDF QA, merge, central QA, Multi-Repo Guard, and fresh Source Snapshot remain mandatory

fre_batch2b.public_ui: standalone guest-first decision tool; not added to nine-card homepage core grid

fre_batch2b.release_gate: Publisher browser/PDF QA, merge, central QA, Multi-Repo Guard, and fresh Source Snapshot remain mandatory

fre_batch2c.sub_batch: Batch 2C — Car Affordability & Auto Decision Core
fre_batch2c.public_ui: standalone guest-first decision tool; not added to nine-card homepage core grid
fre_batch2c.decision_policy: no universal car-price-to-income/payment cutoff and no lender-approval prediction; show household cash room, DTI context, emergency runway, financing cost, stress and user-entered alternative scenarios
fre_batch2c.dependency_policy: reuse existing Loan / EMI, Borrowing Health and Emergency Fund engines; do not duplicate their mathematics
fre_batch2c.release_gate: Publisher browser/PDF QA, merge, central QA, Multi-Repo Guard, and fresh Source Snapshot remain mandatory
